title: Wolfia vs. SafeBase: What to Compare Before You Choose
summary: Choosing between SafeBase and Wolfia? Compare portal filling, answer upkeep, trust center controls, Slack workflows, contract review and tiered vs. flat pricing on a real questionnaire.
body_markdown:
If you’re reading this, you’re probably already dealing with a lot of questionnaires. Maybe SafeBase is working fine for your trust center. Buyers find the docs, request access, and you’re done.


The problem starts when a buyer sends a portal with no export button. An answer needs an engineer to confirm it and sits in Slack for two days. A policy changes and now you’re not sure which old answers are still correct.


These are the things that make questionnaires take up way more time than they should.


SafeBase started with the trust center and added questionnaires later.


Wolfia started with questionnaires. The trust center, Slack workflows, and contract review all run on the same knowledge base.


So instead of comparing feature by feature, let’s look at what actually happens when you put both through a real questionnaire.


## The short version


If you’re already on Drata and mainly need a trust center, SafeBase can do the job.


If questionnaires are taking up a big part of your team’s week, try both on your hardest questionnaire. Use the ugly portal. Throw in a few questions that need an engineer. See what happens.


That’s where you’ll see the difference.


SafeBase Wolfia

Shipping what you ask for On Drata’s roadmap Every week, sometimes the same day

## 1. Questionnaires are our core product


SafeBase’s questionnaire help has two parts, a Chrome extension that fills in answers on the portals it supports, and an AI that drafts from a Knowledge Base your experts fill in and approve ([Drata AIQA page](https://drata.com/products/ai-questionnaire-assistance) ).


It works well for the direct stuff. The harder part is what happens when the questionnaire isn’t straightforward. A buyer who sends a portal login with no export button is the difficult one.


That’s where we’ve spent a lot of our engineering time. Spreadsheets full of macros. Nested tables. Checkboxes inside cells. Questions that only appear after you answer the one above. Portals that never let you export.


Whatever format a questionnaire comes in, Excel, Word, PDF or a portal, Wolfia sends it back filled in, in that same format.


Our Portal Agent works with OneTrust, ServiceNow, ProcessUnity, UpGuard, Zip, Ariba, Coupa and dozens more. It pulls every question onto one screen with an answer and a source for each, sends anything it isn’t sure about to the right expert, and once you approve, fills the whole portal.


At Handshake, 90% of answers now go out without a single edit ([Handshake case study](https://wolfia.com/case-studies/handshake) ).


**Ask in your trial:** Which portals get filled in place, and what happens on one with no export?


Then take your longest portal questionnaire from last quarter and run it through both. Count the clicks.


## 2. Answers that stay up to date


This is one of those things that sounds simple until you actually have to maintain it.


With SafeBase, your team adds documents and answers to the Knowledge Base and keeps it current. If your evidence lives in Drata, some of that information is close by. The rest still depends on someone remembering to update it.


Wolfia reads the documents you already keep up to date in Google Drive, Confluence, Notion, SharePoint and Slack, and re-indexes them as they change. It also learns from the edits your reviewers make.


Every answer links back to the document it came from.


That matters when you’re dealing with a large framework. CAIQ v4 alone has 261 questions across 17 domains. If a few answers are out of date, your reviewer has to start checking everything again.


One customer told us.


> “We don’t have to continually do an annual or quarterly review of our knowledge sources.”


Wolfia customer


The same trust lead told us Wolfia also surfaced more detail around a product change that his team hadn’t fully picked up on yet.


> “If something changes on the product that we weren’t aware of, oftentimes Wolfia gives us more detail that we weren’t, sometimes we didn’t know.”


Wolfia customer


**Ask in your trial:** When a policy changes, does the answer update on its own, or does someone have to go find every affected entry?


## 3. A trust center that does more than host files


SafeBase’s trust center covers the basics, with access approvals, NDA click-through and analytics. Some controls, including product portals and Salesforce auto-approval, sit on higher tiers or cost extra ([Drata plans](https://drata.com/plans) ).


Wolfia’s trust center lives on your own domain and runs on the same knowledge base as your questionnaires.


That means the information your team uses to answer a buyer is the same information the buyer sees in your trust center.


A few things come with it.


- **Unlimited viewers.** No credits or caps on how many buyers come through.
- **Access by product line.** If you sell more than one product, customers of one only see that product’s documents.
- **Salesforce auto-approval.** Current customers and open opportunities can be approved automatically.
- **NDA gating.** One reusable NDA covers your library, and signatures land in the audit log.
- **Analytics tied to revenue.** See views and downloads by account and, with Salesforce or HubSpot connected, how much pipeline is behind them.
- **Subprocessor updates.** Wolfia syncs your subprocessor list from sources like your website or a Notion doc and drafts the customer notification when something changes.


Juicebox had 5,000 trust center views in its first two weeks ([Juicebox case study](https://wolfia.com/case-studies/juicebox) ), and ThoughtSpot runs its security portal on Wolfia.


**Ask in your trial:** Show me how a customer of one product is kept from seeing another product’s documents.


## 4. Built by engineers who ship what you ask for


Wolfia is an engineer-first product.


If something’s wrong, you’re not just filing a ticket and waiting. You’re talking to people who are close to the product and can actually make changes.


We get back to customers within 24 hours and ship customer requests every week. Sometimes a request is live the same day.


With SafeBase, product requests go onto the roadmap of a much bigger company, where questionnaires are one product among many.


Eric Wood from Peregrine put it this way.


> “I was getting same-day responses, often within an hour frankly, or less. That rapid iteration on feedback is what I feed off of.”


Eric Wood


, Information Security & Compliance Manager, Peregrine


**Ask in your trial:** Show me something you shipped because a customer asked for it during their evaluation.


## 5. One of our engineers on your account for the first quarter


Most tools give you a help center when you sign.


We give you an engineer.


For your first quarter, one of our engineers works directly with your team. They connect your sources, tune answers to the way you write, and fix whatever’s off.


They stay until your edit rate, the share of answers your team still has to change, is down to 10 to 20%.


We look closely at edit rate because it’s something you can actually feel.


An answer rate tells you the tool answered a question.


Edit rate tells you how much of that answer your team had to redo.


Stanley, Security Compliance Lead at Handshake, described the onboarding process honestly.


> “The first few months required patience. We had to correct answers, add context, and teach the system our specific language. But now I trust it enough to let other teams use it directly.”


Stanley


, Security Compliance Lead, Handshake


**Ask in your trial:** Who helps us in the first 90 days, and what number tells us it’s working?


## 6. Your experts and sales team work in Slack


Questionnaires always end up needing legal, privacy or engineering.


Those people are busy. Making them log into one more tool is how questions end up sitting around for a week.


SafeBase has a[Slack command](https://drata.com/blog/ask-ai-anything-directly-from-slack) that searches its Trust Library.


With Wolfia, you assign a question to someone in Slack and they answer it right there. No Wolfia account needed.


Your sales team can also ask a hard security question in the middle of a customer call and get an answer with its source, without having to find the security lead first.


Eric from Peregrine told us.


> “Now we have a lot more visibility to these questions that we didn’t even have before.”


Eric Wood


, Information Security & Compliance Manager, Peregrine


**Ask in your trial:** When the AI isn’t sure about an answer, how does it get to the right expert?


Then have a salesperson ask a hard question in Slack and time it.


## 7. Reporting on every plan


SafeBase keeps its revenue analytics on the Enterprise tier, with Salesforce and HubSpot starting at Advanced ([Drata plans](https://drata.com/plans) ).


Every Wolfia plan comes with reporting. Edit rates, how quickly questions get answered, which documents are about to expire, and who looked at what in your trust center.


Connect Salesforce and you can also see how much pipeline was waiting on a questionnaire.


That gives leadership something more useful than simply knowing how many questions the team answered.


**Ask in your trial:** Show me the report I’d send my CISO at the end of the quarter, on the plan I’m actually buying.


## 8. Contract review


SafeBase doesn’t review contracts.


We do, because the security addendum usually shows up right after the questionnaire.


When a customer sends a DPA, MSA or security addendum, Wolfia marks each clause as favorable, needs review, or not applicable against your standard terms, with a source for each.


It keeps a record of every non-standard term you accept, with the deal value from Salesforce next to it.


That gives your team a record of what you’re agreeing to and how often you’re making exceptions.


Wolfia also tracks what you’ve committed to in signed contracts and connects to Ironclad.


**Ask in your trial:** Run your standard security addendum and three recent customer markups through it.


## 9. Keep the compliance platform you have


SafeBase works best inside Drata.


If you’re on something else, you’d be taking on a new platform to get this piece of the workflow.


Wolfia works with whichever compliance platform you already use.


## 10. Pricing


Neither company publishes a dollar amount, so be careful with numbers you read elsewhere.


SafeBase uses tiers. The entry tier covers questionnaire help for 10 questionnaires and up to 100 approved domains. Salesforce starts at Advanced, while SCIM and unlimited API access sit higher up ([Drata plans](https://drata.com/plans) ).


The important thing to model is your actual volume.


If you have 10 questionnaires today and 40 six months from now, understand what happens to the bill before you buy.


Wolfia is one flat price with unlimited usage.


No per-questionnaire credits, no per-seat fees, no viewer limits. If your questionnaire volume doubles, your bill doesn’t. If Wolfia spreads from your security lead to your legal team and sales engineers, the price doesn’t move then either.


Every plan includes every agent on one knowledge base, SOC 2 Type II, SSO and an audit trail ([Wolfia pricing](https://wolfia.com/pricing) ).


**Ask in your trial:** What happens to my bill if our questionnaire volume doubles?


## Our take


If you’re on Drata and want a basic trust center bundled into your compliance stack, SafeBase may be what you need.


If your team spends a big part of the week on questionnaires, we’d evaluate the products a little differently.


Give both products your hardest questionnaire. Use the portal that doesn’t have an export button. Throw in a policy that changed recently. Ask a question that needs an engineer. See how long it takes to get from question to answer.


That’s where the differences between the products become much easier to see. We think that’s where Wolfia wins.


## FAQ


### Can I move my trust center from SafeBase to Wolfia?


Yes. We set it up with you on your own domain, and from then on your trust center and your questionnaire answers come from the same knowledge base.


### Do I need to be on a specific compliance platform?


No. Wolfia works with whichever one you use.


### How does portal filling compare?


SafeBase autofills the portals it supports, but doesn’t publish the list. Wolfia lists the portals it fills, including ones that never let you export, and writes every approved answer back for you.


### What does onboarding look like?


We connect your documents and run a real questionnaire you recently answered in the first session, so you can compare it with what you actually sent.


Then one of our engineers stays with your team through the first quarter, until your edit rate is down to 10 to 20%.
